title: QML Algorithm for Market Pattern Detection in High-Frequency Trading for Banking
journal_or_venue: 2025 International Conference on Intelligent and Secure Engineering Solutions (CISES)
abstract_summary: The paper proposes a quantum machine learning (QML) algorithm for detecting market patterns in high-frequency trading (HFT) aimed at banking institutions, combining classical ML methods with quantum feature mapping and quantum circuit execution to enable faster, more accurate, real-time pattern recognition. It claims improvements in accuracy, real-time detection, scalability and flexibility for HFT, while acknowledging practical challenges such as hardware cost, limited expertise, data security and early-stage quantum technology maturity.
methodology_description: The paper presents a conceptual, proposal-style methodology for a Quantum Machine Learning (QML) system aimed at market pattern detection in high-frequency trading (HFT). The described pipeline fuses classical machine-learning techniques with quantum approaches: (1) ingest and pre-process historical and streaming high-frequency market data (ticks, volumes, indicators), (2) perform a quantum feature mapping to encode classical features into a quantum-representable feature space, (3) train a QML model (the paper refers to a QML algorithm and a "qama" component) using a quantum annealing machine and/or parametrized quantum circuits that exploit superposition and entanglement to capture complex, non-linear correlations, (4) execute quantum circuits (quantum circuit execution) to evaluate/score patterns in near real-time, (5) perform classical readout and post-processing (the "readout expander") to convert quantum outputs into trading signals, and (6) integrate risk-control and decision rules to produce executable HFT orders. The authors emphasize continual learning and adaptation by re-training/updating the model as streaming data arrive. The methodology is high-level; equations are sketched but algorithmic hyperparameters, training procedures, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols are not specified in experimental detail.
algorithms_used: Quantum annealing (quantum annealing machine for training/pre-processing)
Parametrized quantum circuits / quantum circuit execution

results_summary: The conference paper proposes a quantum machine learning (QML) algorithm for market-pattern detection in high-frequency trading for banking, arguing that by leveraging quantum principles (superposition, entanglement) and integrating classical ML, the method can achieve faster, more accurate, and more flexible real-time detection of complex, nonlinear market patterns across many input variables.
